description.value:
The primal spirits exert their powers to protect you. If you are hit by an attack, you may use a Reaction to roll on the Primal Protection table to determine a defensive effect. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom Modifier, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest.

1d6Effect
1–2Protruding Spines: creatures within 5 feet take 2d4 + Wisdom modifier Piercing damage and are pushed 5 feet.
3–4Bulbous Shell: +3 AC until the end of your next turn; the triggering attack can miss.
5Abyssal Glare: until the end of your next turn, a creature that damages you takes Psychic damage equal to twice your Wisdom modifier.
6Aberrant Flesh: regain 2d4 + Wisdom modifier Hit Points after the triggering damage.
